messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert 1778890123 — Observability: sudden drop in exception ingestion into Sentry. Ingestion rate down ~92% vs baseline for last 5m. Auto-escalation to #incidents and paging oncall.

sre-jordan: Ack. On it. Can someone confirm forwarder pods health? I'm running `kubectl get pods -n observability`.

oncall-mira: I got the page and am jumping in.

eng-olivia: Seeing lots of 429s from vendor endpoint in forwarder logs: `POST https://obs-vendor.example.com/ingest` -> 429. Sample:

```
curl -v https://obs-vendor.example.com/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX"
> HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
> Retry-After: 30
{"error":"rate_limited"}
```

infra-raj: Forwarder retries are backoff-limited, queue is backing up. Disk buffer at 78% on forwarder-1.

sre-jordan: So Sentry shows low exceptions because our enrichment step to vendor is rejecting events. Is vendor in-path for all events?

product-mike: Yes — we symbolicate/enrich stacktraces via that vendor synchronously before forwarding to Sentry; it's in-path.

support-anjali: Impact: on-call dashboards not receiving exceptions for multiple customers. Some customer errors are untriaged right now.

ops-bot: Triggering runbook `observability-down-vendor-429` and creating incident ticket INC-2026-045.

oncall-mira: Quick mitigation: flip to bypass enrichment pipeline and send raw events directly to Sentry. Doing canary toggle now via admin console.

eng-olivia: Command to toggle:

```
POST /admin/pipelines/forwarder/config
{"enrichment_enabled": false}
```

oncall-mira: Toggled on canary -> forwarder-2 shows events flowing to Sentry again. Exceptions count partially recovered.

sre-jordan: Rolling toggle across regions. Need to notify vendor and open a support case.

infra-raj: Opening vendor ticket. Vendor incident ID 98765 created. They report "spike in 429s due to auth provider rate-limits", investigating.

product-mike: Impact assessment: Severity S2 (partial loss of exception signals; delayed triage). Affected customers: cust-A, cust-B, cust-C (enterprise with symbolication enabled). Recommend CSM outreach.

support-anjali: I'll start outreach and post customer templates. ETA 30m.

sre-jordan: Handoff: I'll stay on incident until stabilized. @eng-olivia please own postmortem.

eng-olivia: I'll take postmortem. We'll capture root cause and add fallback to direct-to-Sentry.

IncidentBot: Update: Incident severity set to S2. Incident channel pinned with link to INC-2026-045.

oncall-mira: Full toggle rolled across regions. Exceptions back to ~95% baseline. Monitoring for regressions.

ops-bot: Timeline saved: page -> oncall-mira, accepted +2m, mitigation toggle +8m, vendor ack +12m.

sre-jordan: Next steps: 1) Ensure buffered events retained 24h, 2) Add automatic bypass when vendor 429 persists >5m, 3) Customer comms, 4) Postmortem.

product-mike: Consider making enrichment async to avoid blocking Sentry ingestion.

infra-raj: Following up with vendor on auth provider rate-limit root cause; asking for post-incident report.

eng-olivia: Saved logs and forwarded sample to s3://incidents/1778890123/raw-samples.json

sre-jordan: Will close incident in 60m unless regressions. Leaving handoff note here.

oncall-mira: Monitoring mode. Re-page if anything fires.

support-anjali: CSMs notified, customer comms sent.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved: ingress restored, exceptions within 5% of baseline. Auto-close scheduled in 60m.
